proposed_train_metadata.confidence_note: Candidate horn absent_observed. FFT analysis of 16kHz audio from both streams shows low-frequency engine dominance (50-250 Hz) and lack of sustained pneumatic horn spectral peaks in 300-800 Hz (max SNR 6.8). Verified trailing car count: 5 coaches.

T0_first_visible.rationale: Candidate first observed train frame in available recording (Frame 0). Left-censored: locomotive is already visible approaching under corridor at recording start (t=0.00s); true physical visual arrival occurred at t <= 0.00s. Excluded from physical detection-latency denominator.

T1_danger_zone_entry.rationale: Operational Danger-Zone Annotation Convention (Protocol v7.0.0 §2.4, retiring R03): locomotive cowcatcher reaches turnout switch frog / pedestrian approach line on camera_front.mov.

T2_crossing_occupancy_start.rationale: Operational Danger-Zone Annotation Convention (Protocol v7.0.0 §2.4): locomotive pilot crosses front camera transverse lens plane / roadway occupancy line on camera_front.mov.

T3_locomotive_unit_clearance.rationale: Operational Danger-Zone Annotation Convention: trailing edge / rear coupler of lead locomotive clears vegetable vendor stall clearance line on camera_back.mov.

T4_tail_clearance.rationale: Operational Danger-Zone Annotation Convention: rear buffer of final rail vehicle (#5) clears departure roadway boundary on camera_back.mov, permitting road and pedestrian crossing resumption.

T_scene_clear.rationale: Recording terminates while train is still visible receding along departure tracks.

proposed_camera_alignment_markers.stream_exposure_note: Combined camera-stream exposure (120.788s) represents summed stream-seconds and must NOT be treated as concurrent wall-clock exposure.
